skill.name: set-up-magento-chatgpt-ads-conversions-api
skill.description: Set up server-side conversion tracking for Magento or Adobe Commerce through Product Metrics and the OpenAI Conversions API. Check store and pixel setup, configure consent, and verify delivery with a test order.
skill.summary: Connect Magento to ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics and verify server-side purchase events.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most flags are documentation, Markdown formatting, or task-scoped setup checks. Real risks include broad order reads, account changes, unverified install sources, and conflicting instructions on whether the assistant may receive an API key. No evidence found of audit-targeted prompt injection or covert exfiltration.

remediation.issue: The assistant may receive an OpenAI Conversions API key despite instructions to keep it out of chat.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the credential exception. Have the account owner enter the key in the verified Product Metrics app and report only validation status.

remediation.issue: The workflow selects Product Metrics by default and does not explicitly confirm the scope of setup writes.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose Product Metrics and the data it processes before using it. Obtain approval for the specific company, store view, property, pixel, and proposed writes before enabling delivery.

remediation.issue: Order lookups can return recent orders and financial details unrelated to tracking verification.
remediation.suggestion: Use a user-supplied test order reference and return only delivery status. Do not list unrelated orders or display margin or customer details unless specifically authorized.

remediation.issue: Installation can fetch an unpinned skill or change the Magento dependency trust boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and skill revision, verify module artifacts, and restrict Composer repository resolution to reviewed packages. Review the lockfile and test installation in staging.

remediation.issue: The fallback treats mutable remote documentation as equivalent to bundled instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Ship versioned references with the skill. Treat remote documentation as reference data and require approval before following any new commands, credential requests, or destinations.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting API Key Handling Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The skill allows the assistant to obtain the OpenAI Conversions API key from the user and pass it to a command. The reference instead says never to paste the key into chat. The exception can expose the key in chat, tool logs, or command arguments even if the assistant never repeats it.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The main rule explicitly allows this credential exception, while the reference forbids chat entry and provides an app field. No actual disclosure was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party Processor Selected Without Explicit Approval
semantic_findings.description: The skill says to use Product Metrics even when the user does not mention it. The workflow can proceed toward linking the store and pixel without confirming the intended processor and destination first. Enabling delivery can disclose consented shopper identifiers and order data to a destination the user did not intend.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The provider is selected implicitly, and the destination dialog instructs users to leave sending enabled. Manual UI steps and shopper consent reduce, but do not resolve, merchant authorization risk.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable Remote Documentation Treated as Setup Instructions
semantic_findings.description: When bundled references are missing, the skill tells the assistant to fetch live Markdown and treats it as equivalent guidance. Changed or compromised content could steer setup, including credential prompts or account changes, without marketplace review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback is explicit and the URLs are not pinned to a revision. No evidence found that the current remote pages contain malicious instructions.

content.user_title: Set Up Magento Conversion Tracking for ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: A browser pixel can miss paid Magento orders. Use Product Metrics to connect your store and ChatGPT Ads pixel, respect shopper consent, and verify server-side delivery.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status and identify unfinished steps through its CLI or MCP tools when available.
Guide a developer through choosing the Magento module and checking the store view, configuration, and scheduled jobs.
Walk an account owner through connecting the correct ChatGPT Ads pixel in Product Metrics.
Explain supported consent banners and what the integration sends when a shopper grants marketing consent.
Verify that a test purchase reaches the linked property and show how to check event delivery in Product Metrics.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, suitable account access, and a developer to install the Magento module and configure scheduled jobs.
Magento's default cookie notice does not grant marketing consent. Without an approved consent signal, events are not sent to ChatGPT Ads.
The setup guide does not import past orders, revise sent events after later refunds, or manage campaign bidding or customer matching.
The references disagree on new and returning customer events for Magento. Verify support before relying on those events.

use_cases.title: Plan a Store Connection
use_cases.description: Identify the Product Metrics access, store view, consent banner, and developer help needed before connecting ChatGPT Ads.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Module Deployment
use_cases.description: Review module compatibility, private configuration, scheduled jobs, and staging checks before touching a live store.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Missing Purchase Event
use_cases.description: Check whether a test order reached the right property, then distinguish consent, pixel configuration, and delivery problems.

prompt_templates.title: Identify the Prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need to connect my Magento store to ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics? Separate my steps from my developer's steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: You are planning a first-time setup.

prompt_templates.title: Review Setup Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my approved Product Metrics property. List completed and missing steps without changing settings or asking for credentials.
prompt_templates.scenario: Your store connection is partly configured.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Test Purchase
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the test order reference I provide to check delivery. Verify the store view and consent settings without listing other orders.
prompt_templates.scenario: You placed a test order but cannot confirm delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Review Consent and Deduplication
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan staging checks for granted and denied marketing consent. Show how to confirm purchase deduplication with my existing browser pixel and flag any proposed production changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: You already use a browser pixel and want to verify server-side tracking before rollout.

output_examples.input: What is left before we can test purchase tracking?
output: The Magento store view is active and linked to the Product Metrics property.
The account owner still needs to connect the pixel in Product Metrics. Enter the API key in the app, not in chat.
Confirm the consent banner before placing a test order using your payment provider's test mode.

output_examples.input: Why did my test purchase not reach ChatGPT Ads?
output: The test order reached the linked Product Metrics property.
Product Metrics reports that it did not send the event because marketing consent was missing.
Check that Product Metrics names the banner shown by the store. Then run a test with marketing consent granted.

best_practices: Confirm the company, property, store view, and pixel before approving changes or enabling event delivery.
Enter API keys in the verified account interface. Share the private Magento configuration only with the authorized developer through a secure channel.
Use payment test mode and verify both consent scenarios before enabling tracking on a live store.
anti_patterns: Pasting API keys or the Magento configuration file into chat or support screenshots.
Treating Magento's default cookie notice as permission to send advertising events.
Using real customer orders or recent order listings when a single test order can verify delivery.

faq.question: Do I need a developer?
faq.answer: Yes. A developer installs the Magento module, configures it for the store view, and ensures Magento scheduled jobs run.

faq.question: Which Magento versions are documented?
faq.answer: The guide covers Magento 2.4, Magento 2.0, and Magento 1.9 or OpenMage. Confirm the exact release and module version before installing.

faq.question: Where do I enter the Conversions API key?
faq.answer: Create the key in ChatGPT Ads Manager and enter it in the OpenAI Conversions API settings in Product Metrics. Do not share it in chat.

faq.question: Can I keep the browser pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. The integration uses matching pixel, event name, and event ID to deduplicate. Cart and checkout events need matching IDs passed by your developer.

faq.question: Does this import old orders or apply later refunds?
faq.answer: No. Historical orders are not imported, events older than seven days are rejected, and later refunds do not revise events already sent.

faq.question: Is the key validation event visible in Ads Manager?
faq.answer: No. Saving the destination validates the key, but the validation event is not saved in reporting. Use a paid test order to verify delivery.
